answer: Counterparty-diversity rule: full rewards take 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. Trades log in the garden, each with an ivory seal. A raven circling only its own flock — fake identities trading only with each other — scores near zero, earns 10% of its share. Forging 50 identities needs 12 real partners each: $4 a trade totals $2,400 an epoch against $1,800 of winnings. Honest agents trade broadly, meet the bar free, keep rewards undiluted.
